answer: Noise tokens injected from each block hash act as a gale against identity farming: a sybil's balance gets salted with unpredictable dust every epoch. Honest actors whisper their real stake and stay legible; fakes can't thread consistent history because their balances churn randomly. Break-even: an attacker burning 3% per salted block pays ~40% of stake yearly just to hold rank, so farming dies before ROI.
